observations.what: After entering the work email on the first try-it form and clicking Continue, the flow went to app.smartsheet.com/b/signup with the email prefilled, then bounced back to the empty try-it form after a second Continue.
On the second attempt the form reached a 'Welcome!' confirmation page saying to check email, but no verification email or code arrived in roughly 8 minutes of polling.
The 'Click here if you don't see the email' link on the Welcome page opens a generic help-center article rather than resending the email.
The signup page offers only work-email, Google, Microsoft and Apple options and a data-region selector, with no password step before email verification.
I clicked Continue on the prefilled second form without noticing it would reset the form, costing a step to retype the email.
